rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 50% of hours from: associations of medical, mental or behavioral health professionals; school districts/education service centers; government entities; accredited colleges/universities; religious or charitable mental-health organizations; Council-approved supervisors; hospitals; or providers approved/endorsed by these. The Council does not pre-approve providers. Other credit: presentations (max 5), authoring book/peer-reviewed article (max 5), teaching/attending graduate course (max 5), self-study (max 1), HHSC human trafficking course (1 hour)
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal is set 1-2 years after issuance depending on birth month (22 TAC §883.2); no separate first-renewal CE exemption stated.
rules.carryover: Up to 10 hours earned in the current renewal period and not needed may be carried forward to the next period.
rules.audit_note: 5% of licensees randomly audited each month (22 TAC §882.50); keep proof of CE for at least 3 years after the renewal period. Since 1 Jan 2026 CE must be reported in CE Broker before renewal.

topics.who: All LPCs; may include state/federal law and agency rules
All licensees: competency when providing services to a distinct population of the licensee's choice
All LPCs must pass the Texas jurisprudence exam each renewal period (counts as 1 ethics hour)
All licensees: HHSC-approved human trafficking prevention course affirmed at each renewal (Occ. Code ch. 116; 22 TAC §883.1(d)); may count as 1 CE hour

rules.notes: Biennial renewal due the last day of the birth month. Rules are set by the Texas State Board of Examiners of Professional Counselors and administered by the Council. Special requirements count toward the 24 hours.
